purpose: development-only bounded counterfactual candidate generation, not model score or complete determinacy test

rows.query: How many cities are there in England?
rows.target_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM City WHERE District='England'

rows.query: List the languages used in Turkmenistan.
rows.target_sql: SELECT Language FROM CountryLanguage WHERE CountryCode='TKM' ORDER BY Language

rows.query: Provide the name, capital city and its official language of the country with the highest life expectancy.
rows.target_sql: SELECT c.Name,city.Name,l.Language FROM Country c JOIN City city ON c.Capital=city.ID JOIN CountryLanguage l ON c.Code=l.CountryCode WHERE c.LifeExpectancy=(SELECT MAX(LifeExpectancy) FROM Country) AND l.IsOfficial='T'

rows.query: Among the languages used in Baltic Countries, provide the languages which are used by over 80%.
rows.target_sql: SELECT DISTINCT l.Language FROM Country c JOIN CountryLanguage l ON c.Code=l.CountryCode WHERE c.Region='Baltic Countries' AND l.Percentage>80 ORDER BY l.Language

rows.query: Provide the name, located country, and life expectancy of the most populated city
rows.target_sql: SELECT city.Name,c.Name,c.LifeExpectancy FROM City city JOIN Country c ON c.Code=city.CountryCode WHERE city.Population=(SELECT MAX(Population) FROM City)

rows.query: Provide the country, population, capital city, and official language of the country with the smallest surface area.
rows.target_sql: SELECT c.Name,c.Population,city.Name,l.Language FROM Country c JOIN City city ON c.Capital=city.ID JOIN CountryLanguage l ON c.Code=l.CountryCode WHERE c.SurfaceArea=(SELECT MIN(SurfaceArea) FROM Country) AND l.IsOfficial='T'

rows.query: List the district name of the city with the smallest population.
rows.target_sql: SELECT District FROM City WHERE Population=(SELECT MIN(Population) FROM City)

rows.query: In which continent does the country with the smallest surface area belongs?
rows.target_sql: SELECT Continent FROM Country WHERE SurfaceArea=(SELECT MIN(SurfaceArea) FROM Country)

rows.query: Who is the head of the state where the most crowded city belongs?
rows.target_sql: SELECT c.HeadOfState FROM City city JOIN Country c ON c.Code=city.CountryCode WHERE city.Population=(SELECT MAX(Population) FROM City)

rows.query: List down the cities that belong to the country with a life expectancy of 66.4.
rows.target_sql: SELECT city.Name FROM City city JOIN Country c ON c.Code=city.CountryCode WHERE c.LifeExpectancy=66.4 ORDER BY city.ID

excluded.reason: Any five allows multiple valid answers; changing the full eligible set does not necessarily invalidate the requested answer.

scope: SQL projections contain requested fields only, compared as bags. Ten known development tasks; all four original model/prompt traces eligible regardless of final outcome. Reuse same candidates across arms. Existing declared keys and foreign-key columns are excluded; donor values are same-column observations. Other semantic constraints are not certified. No failed search establishes sufficiency.
